title: Spine imaging dataset charting record
description: One record per included dataset. Protocol v1.0 (2026-09-19). Every non-computed value carries a quote in `quotes` whose `field` names the charted field it supports. Enumerations are closed on purpose: a value that does not fit is charted as 'other' or 'unknown' with the detail in `notes`, so that counts stay countable.

id.description: Stable slug, assigned once at record-to-dataset mapping (protocol §7.6), e.g. 'verse', 'ctspinopelvic1k', 'vindr-spinexr'. Never renamed; also the name of recipe/datasets/<id>.sh.

name.description: Name as the primary describing record gives it.

aliases.description: Other names, version names (e.g. 'VerSe 2019', 'VerSe 2020'), challenge names, repository titles.

modality.description: Every modality the dataset contains. At least one must be eligible (not MRI/other); ineligible modalities are listed so multi-modal datasets are described truthfully but their MRI images are not counted.

projection.description: For projection radiography. 'whole-spine' means a single film or stitched film covering at least C7 to S1. CT-only datasets chart ['NA'].

region.description: Regions covered. 'whole-spine' when the description claims C1 (or C2) to sacrum; 'mixed' when regions vary by subject and are not enumerated.

n_subjects.description: Distinct persons. Null when not stated and not computable.

n_subjects_basis.description: 'computed-from-metadata' = counted from released patient identifiers; 'estimated' = derived from a stated ratio (e.g. figures per article) and explained in notes.

pediatric_included.description: 'yes' when any subject under 18 years is stated to be included.

annotation_types.description: 'none' must be the only element when present.

annotation_origin.description: Protocol §4.3 definitions. Several allowed when different annotation types have different origins; notes says which is which.

described.description: Any statement about how annotations were checked.

inter_rater_ci.description: 95 % interval [lower, upper] as reported; null when not reported.

inter_rater_n.description: Number of items (images, vertebrae, subjects) the statistic was computed on.

comparable_group.description: Group key for pooling (SAP §5.5). Assigned by the verifier from the statistic and the annotation type; null when not poolable.

per_vertebra_level_names.description: 'yes' when every annotated vertebra carries an anatomical level name (C1…S1) in the release; 'partial' when only some images or only a region do; 'no' when labels are class-agnostic or absent.

text.description: Licence as stated, verbatim short form (e.g. 'CC BY-NC-SA 4.0', 'PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0', 'custom research-only terms', 'not stated').

tier.description: open = permits redistribution and commercial use (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, ODC, MIT-like); non-commercial = CC BY-NC variants and 'research use only' with redistribution allowed; restricted = no redistribution or DUA-bound; unknown = not stated.

consistent.description: Whether the article and the repository state the same licence; 'single-source' when only one states any.

described_as_public.description: Protocol §4.3. Charted from the text before the probe, never updated from the probe.

access_route.description: Final route after verifier confirmation of the probe (protocol Appendix B).

matched_rule.description: Row of protocol Appendix B that fired, e.g. 'B1-zenodo-open', 'B10-DUA_RE'.

evidence.description: Snippet of page text or API field that justified the class.

year.description: Year of the earliest describing record.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the acquiring institution(s); 'multi' when more than one country.

record_ids.description: Screening record ids (from records.jsonl) that map to this dataset.

size_gb.description: Total download size as stated or as listed by the repository API; null when unknown.

split_defined.description: A train/validation/test partition is released or specified.

patient_level_dedup.description: The split (or the dataset) is stated to keep every subject in one partition and to contain each subject once. 'NA' when one image per subject by construction.

authors_own.description: True when a review author maintains the dataset; such records must have verified_by set to a different author.

field.description: Dot path of the charted field this quote supports, e.g. 'annotation_origin', 'variant_labels.L6'.

source.description: DOI, URL or repository record id.

locator.description: Section, page, README heading or API field.

status.description: 'yes' = present per subject in labels or metadata, or counts reported in text; 'no' = the description states the variant is absent, excluded or not represented; 'unknown' = silent.

how_labelled.description: 'derivable-from-labels' = the label scheme can express it (e.g. a 25th vertebra class) even if no count is published.

n_subjects_assessed.description: Denominator for prevalence; null when the count is given without a denominator (then not poolable).

definition.description: How the source defines the variant (e.g. 'Castellvi II–IV on CT', 'six lumbar-type vertebrae counted from C2', 'not defined').
